title: Schema-driven embedding version contracts, canary rollout, and deprecation playbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem statement: We need a repeatable, low-risk onboarding path for new embedding models and a clear versioning/deprecation contract so hosted and Dedicated customers experience predictable quality, latency, and cost. Current ad-hoc onboarding leads to last-minute regressions (quality or latency), inconsistent migration guidance, and tenant-level surprises during rollouts.

Goals:
- Define a machine-readable model contract (vector dimensionality, dtype, normalization, deterministic vs stochastic, pooling semantics, stable tokenization/encoder) to enable automated compatibility checks.
- Implement a staged canary that supports traffic slices by tenant, percentile ramping, and automated rollback triggers.
- Provide a deprecation playbook including migration timeline, SDK aliases, automatic fallback rules, and reindexing recommendations.
- Integrate quality & latency gates into CI and runtime monitors (precision@k, MRR, p50/p95 latency, cost delta).

High-level approach:
1) Model contract schema: create a JSON Schema for all embedding models stored in the model catalog. Fields: model_id, flavor, vector_size, dtype, normalization, deterministic, max_sequence_tokens, known-tokenizer, compatible_aliases, estimated_cost_per_1K_tokens, recommended_batch_size, latency_profile_reference. This will be validated at catalog registration time.
2) Canary orchestration: extend routing layer to accept rollout policies referencing model alias + contract version. Support percent-based ramps, tenant allowlist, and a gating rule engine that consumes monitoring signals.
3) Compatibility & shim: when a new model violates contract (e.g., different vector size), automatically create a versioned alias and mark it incompatible for existing indices. Provide client-side SDK helpers for on-the-fly conversion warnings, and migration tools for reindexing.
4) Quality/latency gates: add eval harness that runs canonical evals (semantic-sim, rerank A/B, downstream tasks) on a per-model basis. Gate passes required before exceeding 5% traffic.
5) Deprecation & communications: standard 90/30 day deprecation windows (90-day notice to unpinned customers, 30-day to pinned/dedicated), migration docs, automated Alerts to tenants who rely on deprecated aliases.

Why different: This ticket shifts onboarding from informal checklists to a schema-first, automated routing + gating system that reduces manual risk and enables safer rollouts across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployment modes.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Model contract schema exists and is enforced on new catalog registrations. 2) Canary pipeline implements percentage ramping and tenant allowlist, visible in Console with per-tenant snapshot. 3) CI job runs eval harness and blocks merges for +traffic rollouts if precision@10 or MRR regress beyond thresholds. 4) SDK exposes aliasing and migration warnings. 5) Deprecation emails and console notices generated automatically when model is marked deprecated.
tasks: Draft JSON Schema and add validator to model-catalog service
Add contract version field to model metadata and catalog UI
Implement routing policy support for percent ramps and tenant allowlist
Extend observability to emit per-model precision@k and MRR metrics to the rollout guard
Create eval harness job (github actions) that runs canonical reranking datasets and latency microbenchmarks
Add SDK helpers for alias resolution and client-side migration warnings
Write deprecation playbook + email templates and Console banners
Update Dedicated onboarding docs with reindexing guidance and cost delta calculator
